products.name: Nova X1 Pro 5G
products.short: Flagship 5G phone with a 50 MP OIS triple camera, 120 Hz LTPO display and 80 W charging.
products.description: The Nova X1 Pro pairs a 6.7-inch LTPO AMOLED display that scales from 1 to 120 Hz with a 50 MP main camera featuring optical image stabilisation, a 48 MP ultra-wide and a 3x telephoto. The 5000 mAh battery comfortably lasts a full day and refills to 50% in 12 minutes with the included 80 W charger. IP68 dust and water resistance, stereo speakers and four years of Android updates make it a phone you can keep.
specs: 50 MP OIS + 48 MP ultra-wide + 12 MP 3x telephoto

products.name: Nova X1 5G
products.short: Balanced 5G phone with a 120 Hz AMOLED display and 50 MP camera.
products.description: Everything most people need from a phone, done well: a bright 6.5-inch 120 Hz AMOLED screen, a 50 MP main camera with night mode, 8 GB of RAM and a 5000 mAh battery with 45 W charging. The slim aluminium frame and in-display fingerprint sensor give it a premium feel without the flagship price.

products.name: Orbit Lite 5G
products.short: Affordable 5G phone with a 90 Hz display and two-day battery.
products.description: Orbit Lite brings 5G and a smooth 90 Hz display to an honest price. The 6000 mAh battery easily lasts two days of typical use, the 50 MP camera takes sharp daylight photos and the side-mounted fingerprint sensor is quick and reliable.

products.name: Orbit Neo 4G
products.short: Entry-level 4G phone with a large display and 5000 mAh battery.
products.description: A simple, reliable phone for calls, messaging, UPI payments and video. The 6.5-inch HD+ display is easy on the eyes, the 5000 mAh battery lasts well over a day and dual SIM plus a dedicated microSD slot keep things flexible.

products.name: Nova Fold Air
products.short: Book-style foldable with a crease-light 7.8" inner display.
products.description: Nova Fold Air opens into a 7.8-inch tablet-sized AMOLED display for multitasking, reading and video, and closes into a normal-width phone. The redesigned hinge folds flat with a barely visible crease, and the triple camera system matches our flagship.

products.name: Orbit Max 5G
products.short: Big-battery 5G phone with 6000 mAh and 67 W charging.
products.description: Orbit Max is built for people who are always on the move: a 6000 mAh battery, 67 W fast charging, a 6.7-inch 120 Hz display and a 108 MP main camera for detailed shots.

products.name: Aerion Air 14
products.short: 1.2 kg ultrabook with a 2.8K OLED display and 16-hour battery.
products.description: Aerion Air 14 weighs just 1.2 kg yet packs a 2.8K OLED display, a fast 12-core processor and a battery that lasts up to 16 hours of video playback. The fanless-quiet design, backlit keyboard and 1080p webcam make it an ideal companion for work, study and travel.

products.name: Aerion Pro 16 Creator
products.short: 16" 3.2K mini-LED creator laptop with dedicated graphics.
products.description: Built for video editors, designers and developers: a colour-calibrated 16-inch 3.2K mini-LED panel covering 100% DCI-P3, a 16-core processor, dedicated graphics and 32 GB of RAM. The large glass trackpad and six-speaker array round out a serious creative workstation.

products.name: Kestrel G15 Gaming Laptop
products.short: 15.6" 165 Hz gaming laptop with 8 GB dedicated graphics.
products.description: Kestrel G15 delivers smooth high-frame-rate gaming on a 15.6-inch QHD 165 Hz display, powered by a 14-core processor and 8 GB dedicated graphics. The vapour-chamber cooling keeps it quiet under load and the per-key RGB keyboard is tuned for fast, accurate input.

products.name: Kestrel G17 Ultra
products.short: 17.3" 240 Hz flagship gaming laptop.
products.description: The Kestrel G17 Ultra is our most powerful gaming laptop: a 17.3-inch 240 Hz display, 12 GB flagship graphics, 32 GB of RAM and a 2 TB SSD. It is a desktop replacement for competitive players and streamers.

products.name: Aerion Book 15
products.short: Everyday 15.6" laptop for study and office work.
products.description: A dependable 15.6-inch Full HD laptop with a comfortable full-size keyboard and numeric pad, 8 GB of RAM expandable to 32 GB and a fast 512 GB SSD. Perfect for college assignments, spreadsheets and video calls.

products.name: Nova Slate 13 2-in-1
products.short: Convertible 13" touchscreen laptop with stylus support.
products.description: Nova Slate folds from laptop to tablet in one motion. The 13-inch 2K touchscreen supports the included stylus for note-taking and sketching, and the magnesium chassis weighs only 1.1 kg.

products.name: Nova Tab S9 11"
products.short: 11" 120 Hz tablet with quad speakers and stylus support.
products.description: An 11-inch 2.5K 120 Hz display, quad speakers tuned for movies and a pressure-sensitive stylus make the Nova Tab S9 a great device for streaming, note-taking and light editing.

products.name: Nova Tab Lite 10
products.short: 10.4" family tablet for video, reading and online classes.
products.description: A lightweight 10.4-inch tablet with a 2K display, dual speakers and a 7040 mAh battery - great for online classes, e-books and binge-watching.

products.name: Lumina Pad Pro 12.9
products.short: 12.9" mini-LED pro tablet for artists and editors.
products.description: Lumina Pad Pro features a stunning 12.9-inch mini-LED display with 1600 nits peak brightness, a desktop-class chip and Thunderbolt connectivity. Pair it with the Lumina Pencil for precise, lag-free drawing.

products.name: Lumina Pad Mini 8
products.short: Pocketable 8.3" tablet for reading and travel.
products.description: Small enough for one hand yet big enough for comics, maps and notes. The 8.3-inch laminated display is bright and sharp, and the tablet weighs only 293 g.

products.name: Orbit Kids Tab 8
products.short: Rugged kids tablet with parental controls and a drop-proof case.
products.description: An 8-inch tablet designed for children, with a drop-proof bumper case, blue-light filter, time limits and a curated kids profile. Parents can manage apps and screen time remotely.

products.name: Auralite Pulse ANC Wireless Headphones
products.short: Adaptive noise-cancelling wireless headphones with 40-hour battery.
products.description: Auralite Pulse blocks out traffic, flights and office chatter with adaptive hybrid noise cancellation. 40 mm drivers deliver rich, balanced sound, the memory-foam cushions stay comfortable for hours and a 10-minute charge gives 5 hours of playback. Multipoint Bluetooth connects to your phone and laptop at once.

products.name: Auralite Studio Pro Headphones
products.short: Hi-res studio headphones with wired and wireless modes.
products.description: Tuned with studio engineers, Studio Pro reproduces detail with 50 mm beryllium-coated drivers and supports hi-res audio over cable or LDAC Bluetooth. Ideal for audiophiles, musicians and podcasters.

products.name: Arcadia Strike Wireless Gaming Headset
products.short: Low-latency 2.4 GHz wireless gaming headset with 7.1 surround and detachable mic.
products.description: Arcadia Strike gives you a competitive edge with 2.4 GHz lossless wireless (under 20 ms latency) plus Bluetooth for your phone. 7.1 virtual surround helps you pinpoint footsteps, the detachable noise-reducing mic keeps comms clear and the 50-hour battery outlasts any gaming session. Works with PC, PlayStation and mobile.

products.name: Arcadia Raid Wired Gaming Headset
products.short: Wired RGB gaming headset with 50 mm drivers and a flip-to-mute mic.
products.description: A comfortable, lightweight wired headset for every platform. 50 mm drivers produce punchy bass, the flip-to-mute microphone is always within reach and subtle RGB lighting matches your setup.

products.name: Auralite Buds Pro TWS
products.short: True wireless ANC earbuds with spatial audio and wireless charging.
products.description: Auralite Buds Pro fit securely and seal out noise with 45 dB active noise cancellation. Spatial audio makes movies immersive, six microphones keep calls clear and the pocketable case supports wireless charging for up to 36 hours total playback.

products.name: Auralite Buds Lite
products.short: Everyday true wireless earbuds with 30-hour battery.
products.description: Comfortable, splash-resistant earbuds with a low-latency game mode, quick pairing and 30 hours of total playback. Great value for workouts and commutes.

products.name: Auralite Pulse Lite On-Ear Headphones
products.short: Lightweight on-ear wireless headphones in pastel colours.
products.description: Foldable, lightweight and colourful, Pulse Lite delivers clear sound and 50 hours of battery life for everyday listening.

products.name: Sonique Studio 2.0 Bookshelf Speakers
products.short: Powered bookshelf speakers with Bluetooth, optical and HDMI ARC.
products.description: Real wood cabinets, 5.25-inch woofers and silk-dome tweeters give these powered speakers a warm, detailed sound. Connect your TV over HDMI ARC, your turntable or phone - the included remote switches inputs instantly.

products.name: Sonique Home Mini Smart Speaker
products.short: Compact smart speaker with voice assistant and multi-room audio.
products.description: Play music, set timers and control smart home devices by voice. Sonique Home Mini fills small rooms with 360 degree sound and groups with other Sonique speakers for multi-room playback.

products.name: Tempo Active 2 Smartwatch
products.short: AMOLED fitness smartwatch with SpO2, 100+ sports modes and 14-day battery.
products.description: Tempo Active 2 tracks heart rate, SpO2, sleep and stress around the clock and recognises over 100 workouts, from running to badminton. The 1.43-inch AMOLED display is readable in sunlight, Bluetooth calling lets you answer from your wrist and the battery lasts up to 14 days.

products.name: Tempo Pro GPS Smartwatch
products.short: Dual-band GPS sports watch with training readiness and maps.
products.description: For runners, cyclists and hikers: dual-band GPS for precise tracks, offline maps, training load and recovery insights, and a sapphire glass display. Up to 20 days in smartwatch mode.

products.name: Orbit Band 7 Fitness Tracker
products.short: Slim fitness band with AMOLED display and 2-week battery.
products.description: Track steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts with a light band you forget you are wearing. The 1.62-inch AMOLED display shows notifications at a glance.

products.name: Orbit Classic Hybrid Watch
products.short: Analogue-style hybrid smartwatch with step and sleep tracking.
products.description: Classic analogue looks with discreet smart features: step and sleep tracking, vibrating notifications and a battery that lasts up to 6 months.

products.name: Tempo Sport Smartwatch
products.short: Budget smartwatch with Bluetooth calling and heart-rate tracking.
products.description: A big 1.85-inch display, Bluetooth calling, heart-rate and SpO2 tracking and 7-day battery life at an easy price.

products.name: Nova Watch 4 LTE
products.short: Premium LTE smartwatch with ECG and sapphire display.
products.description: Leave your phone at home: Nova Watch 4 LTE takes calls, streams music and tracks runs on its own. ECG, blood oxygen and temperature sensing keep an eye on your health.

products.name: Pixelcraft 27" 4K UHD IPS Monitor
products.short: 27" 4K IPS monitor with HDR400 and USB-C 65 W.
products.description: Sharp 4K text and 95% DCI-P3 colour make this 27-inch IPS monitor ideal for design, photo editing and productivity. A single USB-C cable carries video, data and 65 W charging to your laptop.

products.name: Pixelcraft 27" QHD 165Hz Gaming Monitor
products.short: 27" 1440p 165 Hz fast-IPS gaming monitor with 1 ms response.
products.description: Fast IPS delivers 1 ms response times and vivid colour at 165 Hz. Adaptive sync eliminates tearing, and the QHD resolution is the sweet spot for competitive and cinematic games alike.

products.name: Pixelcraft 34" Ultrawide Curved Monitor
products.short: 34" WQHD 1500R curved ultrawide for multitasking and immersion.
products.description: A 34-inch 21:9 canvas replaces two monitors for spreadsheets, timelines and code, and pulls you into racing and flight sims with its 1500R curve and 144 Hz refresh.

products.name: Lumina 24" FHD IPS Monitor
products.short: Slim-bezel 24" Full HD IPS monitor with eye-care modes.
products.description: An affordable 24-inch Full HD IPS monitor with a three-side borderless design, flicker-free backlight and low blue light mode for long work and study sessions.

products.name: Pixelcraft 32" 4K Creator Monitor
products.short: 32" 4K factory-calibrated monitor with USB-C 90 W and KVM.
products.description: Factory-calibrated to Delta E < 1 with 99% Adobe RGB, this 32-inch 4K display is built for photographers and video colourists. The built-in KVM switch controls two computers with one keyboard and mouse.

products.name: Kestrel 25" 240Hz Esports Monitor
products.short: 24.5" Full HD 240 Hz monitor for competitive shooters.
products.description: 240 Hz refresh and 0.5 ms response time give you the clearest motion in fast shooters. Black-level equaliser reveals enemies in dark corners.

products.name: Keyforge K75 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard
products.short: 75% hot-swappable wireless mechanical keyboard with gasket mount.
products.description: The K75 connects over 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth or USB-C and switches between three devices at the tap of a key. Gasket-mounted plates and sound-dampening foam give a deep, satisfying typing sound, and hot-swappable sockets let you try new switches without soldering.

products.name: Keyforge K100 RGB Mechanical Keyboard
products.short: Full-size RGB gaming keyboard with media dial and wrist rest.
products.description: A full-size mechanical keyboard with per-key RGB, a dedicated media dial, macro keys and a magnetic memory-foam wrist rest. Optical switches actuate at 1.2 mm for lightning-fast input.

products.name: Keyforge K65 Compact Keyboard
products.short: 65% compact mechanical keyboard with PBT keycaps.
products.description: Compact 65% layout with arrow keys, hot-swappable switches and retro-inspired PBT keycaps. Frees up desk space for bigger mouse movements.

products.name: Keyforge Pastel PBT Keycap Set
products.short: 142-key pastel PBT keycap set compatible with most layouts.
products.description: Thick dye-sublimated PBT keycaps in a cheerful pastel colourway. 142 keys cover full-size, TKL, 75% and 65% boards with MX-style stems.

products.name: Clicktron Slim Wireless Keyboard
products.short: Quiet low-profile wireless keyboard for office and home.
products.description: Low-profile scissor keys, a quiet typing feel and a 24-month battery life. Connects via a tiny USB receiver.

products.name: Clicktron Keys Bluetooth Keyboard
products.short: Minimal aluminium Bluetooth keyboard for laptops and tablets.
products.description: A clean, minimal aluminium keyboard that pairs with up to three devices over Bluetooth and recharges via USB-C.

products.name: Clicktron Viper Ultralight Gaming Mouse
products.short: 58 g honeycomb gaming mouse with 26K DPI sensor.
products.description: At just 58 g, the Viper glides effortlessly for fast flicks. The 26,000 DPI optical sensor tracks flawlessly, optical switches are rated for 90 million clicks and the paracord-style cable feels wireless.

products.name: Clicktron Glide Pro Wireless Mouse
products.short: Ergonomic wireless productivity mouse with MagSpeed scroll.
products.description: Sculpted for all-day comfort with a thumb rest, silent clicks and an electromagnetic scroll wheel that flies through long documents. Tracks on glass and pairs with three devices.

products.name: Arcadia Hydra RGB Gaming Mouse
products.short: RGB gaming mouse with 8 programmable buttons.
products.description: Arcadia Hydra combines a 16K DPI sensor, eight programmable buttons and vivid RGB lighting that syncs with the rest of your setup.

products.name: Clicktron Silent M2 Wireless Mouse
products.short: Silent-click compact wireless mouse with 18-month battery.
products.description: A compact, ambidextrous mouse with 90% quieter clicks - ideal for libraries, shared offices and late-night work.

products.name: Arcadia Titan MMO Gaming Mouse
products.short: Tunable-weight MMO mouse with 12 side buttons.
products.description: Built for MMOs and MOBAs with 12 programmable side buttons, adjustable weights and onboard memory for five profiles.

products.name: Voltix 20000mAh 65W PD Power Bank
products.short: 20000 mAh power bank that charges laptops at 65 W.
products.description: Charge a laptop, tablet and phone simultaneously with 65 W USB-C Power Delivery. 20000 mAh is enough for four phone charges or one full laptop top-up, and the smart display shows remaining charge to the percent. Airline-safe for cabin baggage.

products.name: Voltix 10000mAh Magnetic Wireless Power Bank
products.short: Slim magnetic wireless power bank that snaps to your phone.
products.description: Snaps magnetically onto compatible phones and charges wirelessly while you keep using them. A USB-C port charges wired devices at 20 W.

products.name: Voltix 65W GaN 3-Port Charger
products.short: Compact 65 W GaN charger for laptop, phone and earbuds.
products.description: Gallium nitride technology makes this 65 W charger half the size of a standard laptop brick. Two USB-C ports and one USB-A share power intelligently between devices.

products.name: Voltix 140W GaN Desktop Charging Station
products.short: 4-port 140 W desktop charger for your entire setup.
products.description: One charger for your whole desk: 140 W across three USB-C ports and one USB-A, enough for a 16-inch laptop, tablet and phone at once.

products.name: Voltix 15W Wireless Charging Pad
products.short: Slim 15 W Qi wireless charging pad.
products.description: Drop your phone or earbuds on the pad to charge at up to 15 W. Foreign-object detection and temperature control keep charging safe.

products.name: Stackr USB-C to USB-C 100W Braided Cable (2 m)
products.short: 2 m braided USB-C cable rated for 100 W charging.
products.description: A durable nylon-braided cable tested for 30,000 bends, carrying up to 100 W for laptops and 480 Mbps data.

products.name: Trekline Commuter Laptop Backpack
products.short: Water-resistant 25 L backpack with padded 16" laptop sleeve.
products.description: A clean, water-resistant backpack with a suspended 16-inch laptop sleeve, quick-access front pocket, luggage pass-through and a hidden anti-theft pocket.

products.name: Stackr 1TB Portable NVMe SSD
products.short: Pocket-sized 1 TB SSD with 1050 MB/s transfers.
products.description: Back up photos, carry projects and edit video directly from this rugged NVMe SSD. USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 delivers up to 1050 MB/s, and the aluminium shell survives 2 m drops.

products.name: Stackr 7-in-1 USB-C Hub
products.short: USB-C hub with 4K HDMI, 100 W pass-through and SD readers.
products.description: Turn one USB-C port into seven: 4K 60 Hz HDMI, 100 W power pass-through, two USB-A 3.0 ports, a USB-C data port and SD/microSD readers.
specs: HDMI 4K60, 2x USB-A 3.0, USB-C data, SD, microSD, USB-C PD in

products.name: Lumina 1080p Streaming Webcam
products.short: 1080p 60 fps webcam with autofocus and dual mics.
products.description: Look sharp on calls and streams with 1080p at 60 fps, fast autofocus, automatic light correction and dual noise-reducing microphones. Includes a privacy shutter.

products.name: Arcadia Pro Wireless Controller
products.short: Wireless controller with Hall-effect sticks for PC and mobile.
products.description: Drift-resistant Hall-effect thumbsticks and triggers, two remappable back buttons and 20-hour battery life. Connects to PC over 2.4 GHz and to phones over Bluetooth.

products.name: Arcadia XL RGB Desk Mat
products.short: 900 x 400 mm RGB desk mat with stitched edges.
products.description: A full-desk surface for keyboard and mouse with a smooth micro-weave cloth, anti-slip rubber base and edge RGB lighting.
